resources.string:
At EventsHigh, our mission is to be the go to destination for finding best local events. We crawl the web for event related information and bring them all at one place. Our users can explore the gamut of events by using navigation tools that allow them to discover events by their interests, their locality or just see the best events to go to for any given day. We also notify our users whenever any event for their interest comes up so that they don\'t have to worry about missing an event again!
\n\nAs a good citizen, we always provide the attribute to the source from whom we got the event data.

We do not collect any user identifiable information like mobile no, address or email address unless users gives us consent explicitly.


We might share user information with third parties only if user agrees to it. e.g. We might share user email address with event organizer so that he can get updates on events from organizer.


We do collect the user interactions at aggregate level so that we can understand user behaviour and provide them with better service.

We have used the following tools to build few icons in our app. 
 Icons8 
 Iconion


We have used the Google Places API and Google Geocoding API for identifying places and showing user location.
